skills.name: skill-creator
skills.purpose: Create, edit and improve Agent Skills, run evals and benchmarks on them, and optimize descriptions for reliable triggering.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when the user wants to create or improve a skill; Python for the eval scripts.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic; skills.sh 397K installs; aitmpl #1 skill (16.8K downloads); Smithery verified; in all major awesome lists

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.purpose: Socratic design session before any creative/feature work: explores intent, constraints and alternatives, then writes a validated design/spec.
skills.how_to_use: Auto-triggers before building features (superpowers plugin) or invoke /brainstorming.
skills.evidence: Superpowers 294k stars; skills.sh 384K installs; aitmpl 10.2K downloads; on mcpservers.org; top pick in 2026 roundups

skills.name: using-superpowers
skills.purpose: Bootstrap skill for the Superpowers plugin: establishes that the agent must look for and invoke relevant skills before any response, and how to find them.
skills.how_to_use: Loaded at session start by the Superpowers plugin; the entry point that makes the other superpowers skills (brainstorming, writing-plans, etc.) fire reliably.
skills.evidence: obra/superpowers 294k stars; skills.sh 258k installs; mcpservers.org listed; known gap
skills.notes: Most useful alongside the rest of Superpowers; subagents are told to ignore it.

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.purpose: Turns a spec into a bite-sized, test-first implementation plan with exact files, code and verification steps for an engineer with zero context.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when you have requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 266.5K installs; aitmpl 1.6K downloads; skills.sh Hot list this week

skills.name: subagent-driven-development
skills.purpose: Executes a plan by dispatching a fresh subagent per task with two-stage review (spec compliance, then code quality) between tasks.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in Claude Code.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 220.3K installs

skills.name: caveman
skills.purpose: Terse 'caveman' response mode that cuts filler and token usage while keeping every technical fact.
skills.how_to_use: Invoke /caveman or say 'be brief'/'less tokens'; stays on until 'stop caveman'. Repo also ships caveman-commit, caveman-compress and safe-refactor.
skills.evidence: Repo created Apr 2026, 109k stars; skills.sh 554K installs, trending #99 (caveman-commit/-learn/safe-refactor also trending)

skills.name: find-skills
skills.purpose: Helps the agent discover and install relevant skills from the open skills ecosystem when the user asks 'is there a skill for X'.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on capability-discovery questions; uses the `npx skills` CLI.
skills.evidence: Most-installed skill on skills.sh (3.7M); claudemarketplaces top skill; skills.sh trending #9 (Oct 2026)

skills.name: grilling
skills.purpose: The actual interview engine behind grill-me: maps a plan as a design tree and asks the user frontier questions in numbered rounds with recommended answers until shared understanding.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'grill me' and similar; grill-me and grill-with-docs are thin wrappers that call this skill, so install it alongside them.
skills.evidence: mattpocock/skills 275k stars; skills.sh 821k installs
skills.notes: Existing entry grill-me (7 lines) just calls 'grilling'; without this skill grill-me does nothing.

skills.name: handoff
skills.purpose: Compacts the current conversation into a handoff document so a fresh agent session can pick up the work without losing context.
skills.how_to_use: Invoke manually (/handoff, model-invocation disabled) with what the next session is for; writes to the OS temp dir. Sibling claude-handoff launches a background agent instead.
skills.evidence: mattpocock/skills 275k stars; skills.sh 907k installs (top-10 overall)
skills.notes: Short SKILL.md (16 lines) but complete; manual-only.

skills.name: grill-me
skills.purpose: Has Claude relentlessly interview you about a plan or design until every branch of the decision tree is resolved.
skills.how_to_use: Invoke explicitly ('grill me') before implementing a plan.
skills.evidence: mattpocock/skills 275k stars; skills.sh 1.3M installs; claudemarketplaces top-3; skills.sh trending #20
skills.notes: Very short prompt-style skill (a few lines); value is the pattern, not depth. Related: grill-with-docs (1.1M).

skills.name: writing-skills
skills.purpose: Applies TDD to skill authoring: pressure-test scenarios with subagents, watch baseline fail, write the skill, close loopholes, verify before deploying.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when creating or editing skills.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 204.6K installs

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.purpose: Executes a written plan inline in batches with review checkpoints when subagents aren't used.
